Chhattisgarh achieves 99.34% geo-tagging success under Bhu-Gram GIS initiative

2026-09-26 The Hitavada Chhattisgarh, geo-tagging, GIS mapping, Bhu-Gram, rural infrastructure, India, panchayat, transparency, field survey, Bastar, Surguja
Read the source article

Quick summary

Chhattisgarh has achieved 99.34% geo-tagging of its assets under the Bhu-Gram GIS initiative, overcoming challenges in remote forest tracts and hilly regions with poor network connectivity through coordination of field staff, panchayat representatives, and technical personnel.

Key takeaways

  • Chhattisgarh achieved 99.34% geo-tagging of its assets, ranking among the top-performing states in India
  • GIS mapping conducted under the 'Bhu-Gram' initiative is bolstering transparency in rural asset management
  • The task was particularly complex in remote forest tracts, hilly regions, and areas with poor network connectivity
  • Bastar and Surguja divisions presented the greatest challenges due to their remote and difficult terrain
  • Success was achieved through coordination of field staff, Panchayat representatives, and technical personnel
  • The geo-tagging program covers rural infrastructure assets across the state's panchayat system
